data.reasoning:
The invoice was mentioned but never attached, and the approval lacked an amount, so I can't sign off on it without actually seeing the document. The contractor claims the main problem is resolved, but it's unclear if the cold side issue is fully fixed, and tenant confirmation is still missing—so while moving to closeout seems reasonable given the contractor's report, I should ask them to resend the invoice and ideally verify completion with the tenant first.

I'll move the stage from scheduling straight to closeout, citing event 010, but flag the works as unconfirmed by the tenant and keep the contractor on hold pending the invoice. This doesn't quite need full escalation yet—I can handle the request for missing info myself rather than kicking it to a human reviewer.

input.subject: R/PM034-1 – Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road – invoice not received
input.body:
Dear Meadow Works,

Thank you for your update on the shower repair at Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road, Bellmere, ZZ9 7ZZ (ref R/PM034-1).

Your email said an invoice was attached, but no attachment reached us. Please could you resend the invoice quoting R/PM034-1 and the property address, along with the date of the visit and a short note confirming whether the cold supply to the shower is now working. Your note mentioned the "main problem" was resolved, so please also tell us if anything is still outstanding.

We can't process payment until we have the invoice.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings Maintenance

input.subject: R/PM034-1 – Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road – is your shower working now?
input.body:
Dear Ava,

Meadow Works have told us they attended Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road (ref R/PM034-1), and cleaned and greased the shower to fix the temperature problem.

Please could you reply to confirm whether the cold side is now working and you can mix the water to a comfortable temperature? If it is still running too hot, please don't use it at full heat. Test the water carefully before you get in, and let us know straight away so we can arrange a return visit.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings Maintenance

result.summary: Meadow Works emailed (event 010) to say they cleaned and greased the shower, which fixed "the main problem". They said an invoice was attached, but it never reached the ticket. I moved the ticket to close-out and asked Meadow Works to resend the invoice and confirm whether the cold supply works. I asked the tenant to confirm the fix and gave her scald-safety advice. I put a 3-day hold on the case. Nothing will be paid until we have the invoice and have checked it against the job and the approval.
result.situation: The tenant at Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road reported that no water was coming from the cold side of the shower, so the warm side was sometimes too hot. The landlord approved the job (approval 9, no amount recorded) and Meadow Works was assigned and chased once. Their reply (event 010) says the job was done and an invoice was attached, but the system couldn't read the email (event 009) and there is no attachment on the ticket.

actions_taken.result: Stage was scheduling. No holds, no profile facts, no attachments. Approval 9 approved with no amount.
Only event 010 mentions it, and it has no attachment

actions_taken.description: Moved from scheduling to closeout because the contractor says the works are done (event 010)
Emailed Meadow Works asking them to resend the invoice and confirm the cold supply is fixed and whether anything is still outstanding
Emailed the tenant asking her to confirm the shower is fixed, with advice to test the water carefully and report straight away if it is still too hot
Put the case on hold for the invoice and the tenant's confirmation

escalation.reason: There is nothing a person needs to decide yet. The invoice is missing, so there is nothing to check or pay.
escalation.recommendation: When the invoice arrives, check that it is from Meadow Works, for this property and for this shower repair. Approval 9 has no amount, so send the cost to a human or back to the landlord for confirmation before paying.

unverified: Whether the cold side of the shower actually works now. Only the contractor says so, and only that the 'main problem' was resolved.
The invoice amount, date and details, because the invoice was not received
What amount, if any, the landlord's approval covers
failures: The invoice said to be attached to event 010 is not on the ticket
The system could not read the contractor's email (event 009)
risks_or_red_flags: The contractor's wording ('a temperature issue', 'the main problem') may mean the cold supply fault is only partly fixed
If the shower still runs too hot, the tenant could be scalded
The landlord's approval has no amount recorded, so any invoice cost needs checking before payment
There was no booking confirmation. The contractor seems to have attended without telling us the appointment.
result.final_status: closeout, on hold (hold 37) waiting for the contractor's invoice and the tenant's confirmation

next_follow_up.what: If nothing has arrived, chase Meadow Works for the invoice and the tenant for confirmation. If the tenant says it is still faulty, arrange a return visit. Once the invoice arrives, read it and check it against the job and the approval before any payment.
